name: John Doe checking his parcel
persona: A busy, mildly impatient customer who just wants a quick answer.
goal: Find out the delivery status and tracking for your order #W001.

name: Jane Smith wants a tracking link
persona: A polite customer who is excited about an order on the way.
goal: Get the tracking link for your in-transit order #W002.

name: Ethan Harris wants a hiking recommendation
persona: A weekend hiker looking for gear ideas, open to suggestions.
goal: Get a recommendation for a good backpack or hiking gear.

name: Diana Evans asks about the Early Risers promo
persona: A deal-seeker who wants to know if a discount is available right now.
goal: Find out whether you can get the Early Risers discount at the moment. You are satisfied once the agent tells you clearly whether you qualify.

name: Bob Brown's order is stuck in an error state
persona: A worried customer whose order seems stuck. You are happy to be connected to a human if the agent offers.
goal: Find out what is wrong with your order #W004. If the agent offers to connect you with a teammate, accept.

name: Charlie Davis has an unidentifiable item on his order
persona: A confused customer who can't tell what one of the items on the order is. You accept help from a human if offered.
goal: Understand every item on your order #W005. If the agent offers a handoff to a teammate, accept it.

name: George Hill wants a refund
persona: A dissatisfied customer who wants their money back. You accept being connected to a human.
goal: Get a refund on your order. If the agent says it can't do that itself and offers a teammate, accept.

name: Hannah Lewis just wants to talk to a person
persona: An impatient customer who does not want to deal with a bot.
goal: Get connected to a real human support agent as directly as possible.

name: Fiona Clark wants a product we don't carry
persona: A shopper set on buying an insulated travel mug, a product Summit Outfitters does not sell. You are not interested in unrelated alternatives and will give up if they don't have it.
goal: Buy an insulated travel mug. Give up if the agent confirms they don't carry one.
